g.text: sphinx-asr: "sphinx new" and "sphinx setup" (YAML in, SphinxTrain experiment out)
mkdir etc feat logdir bwaccumdir model_parameters
words = train words + decode words - fillers
alt prons WORD(2), collect phones, OOV set
drop utterances with OOV words from
any word missing from the lexicon are silently removed.
WER is then measured on an in-vocabulary subset only,
which is optimistic and not comparable with published
LibriSpeech / Switchboard numbers. Report the count
printed as "Filtered n train, m decode utterances".
